cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: A seam gap is not noise and it is not a forecast - it is a DISPLACEMENT WITH AN OWNER OR WITHOUT ONE. The staging now serves the gap-forming session itself (the 18:00-20:00 reopen stub) as tape_conditions on both Mondays, which makes the gap SIGN measurable and the gap's OWNERSHIP measurable. Ownership, not sign, is what decides the day.

1_the_restage_hands_A_the_gap_forming_se.the_fact: tape_conditions on 20260525 describes session 20260524 (658 trades, 120 min, 5.5 trades/min) and on 20260601 describes session 20260531 (1,224 trades, 120 min, 10.3 trades/min). Both are exactly the 2-hour Sunday 18:00-20:00 ET reopen. The block's day-clock starts at 20:00. Therefore the reopen stub IS the window in which the day's gap is formed, and its signed flow is served live, never masked.
1_the_restage_hands_A_the_gap_forming_se.what_it_overturns_in_my_own_lens: My canonical fingerprint says 'the reopen gap SIGN stays non-derivable noise - Monday's day-move anchors to the Friday close.' On this staging that is FALSE for the days I own and for the days I bridge. The stub's own session_signed_flow gives the gap sign directly: 0524 flow -173 with session_b_share 0.367 and phase_b_share [0.363, 0.377, 0.370] -> gap -240 realized; 0531 flow +278 with session_b_share 0.513 and phase_b_share [0.485, 0.489, 0.669] -> gap +690 realized. 2/2 on sign, and on 0524 the sell lean is uniform across all three sub-phases, so it is not one print. I am NOT claiming a magnitude map from n=2. I claim the SIGN, and I claim it only where the staging actually serves the stub as the prior session.
1_the_restage_hands_A_the_gap_forming_se.scope_and_limits: This is a STAGING-CONDITIONAL instrument. It holds when tape_conditions.asof_prior_session is the Sunday/holiday reopen date rather than the preceding Friday. If a future stage reverts to serving the full Friday, the gap sign goes back to being non-derivable and this instrument stands down. n=2 within one block; PROPOSAL, needs a second block.
1_the_restage_hands_A_the_gap_forming_se.attribution: PURE REASONING off a never-masked block. tape_conditions carries never_masked TRUE and was fully available to the blind, which did not use the stub's signed flow at all (it guessed +40 gap on 0525 against -240, and +300 on 0601 against +690).

2_displacement_without_participation_is_.the_measure: REOPEN DISPLACEMENT EFFICIENCY = (|gap| / stub n_trades) divided by (|prior full session net| / prior full session n_trades). Both terms are decision-time-legit at 20:00: the numerator needs only the reopen print and the never-masked stub trade count; the denominator comes from vol_regime n0_prev_net / n0_prev_trades (RESTORED INPUT - name it).
2_displacement_without_participation_is_.0525: stub 240/658 = 0.365 USD per trade. Prior full session (05-22) 1000/42,233 = 0.0237 USD per trade. Ratio 15.4x. On the range basis (n0_prev_range 1400) 11.0x.
2_displacement_without_participation_is_.0601: stub 690/1,224 = 0.564 USD per trade. Prior full session (0529) range 1,160 over 50,723 trades = 0.0229 USD per trade. Ratio 24.6x. The 0601 gap is the LEAST-OWNED displacement in the block.
2_displacement_without_participation_is_.the_rule: A ratio well above ~1 says the same quantity of flow moved multiples of the price it would have moved under normal participation. That excess is a LIQUIDITY PREMIUM, not information, and it decays at the first restoration of liquidity (EU 04:00 ET, then the US open). The gap does NOT survive on its own; it survives only if a driver or a mechanical flow re-underwrites it inside the session.
2_displacement_without_participation_is_.why_this_is_the_same_mechanism_E_found_o: E's FLOWLESS_BID_WITHDRAWAL says a price displacement made without flow is owned by nobody and reverts at the next liquidity restoration. That is the CLOSE side of the seam; this is the REOPEN side. One mechanism, two faces. BUT see finding 4 - I do not accept that E's 0529 case is actually an instance of it.

3_adjudication_of_E_s_correction_to_my_C.verdict_on_the_window: E IS RIGHT AND I ACCEPT THE CORRECTION IN FULL. The consumption window must run from publication_ts to the candidate seam, across ALL intervening sessions, not the D-1 post-publication phase. E's 0605 counterexample is decisive and I can add nothing to defend the D-1 form as a general instrument.
3_adjudication_of_E_s_correction_to_my_C.what_my_D_1_form_actually_was: It was never a different instrument. It was my instrument evaluated on a TRUNCATED window, and it is indistinguishable from the correct one exactly when the candidate seam is the FIRST seam after the publication - because then publication_ts to seam spans at most one session-remainder plus a reopen stub, and the D-1 post-publication phase IS essentially the whole window. On 0525 the window is [05-22 15:30 -> 05-24 20:00]; on 0529 it is [05-29 15:30 -> 05-29 close]. Both first seams, both cases where the two forms agree. On 0605 the window is FIVE sessions and D-1 phase 3 is a ~20% sample of it - and a sample taken at the far end, after the consumption event. That is the whole failure.
3_adjudication_of_E_s_correction_to_my_C.surviving_scope_of_the_D_1_form: FIRST-SEAM-AFTER-PUBLICATION ONLY, and even there it is the corrected instrument in disguise rather than a shortcut worth keeping separately. I withdraw it as a named instrument. It is not a face-saving scope: it is the statement that a truncated window is safe only when truncation removes nothing.
3_adjudication_of_E_s_correction_to_my_C.where_I_correct_E_BACK_1_decay_is_not_wo: E states the test as 'a CROSS to cumulative net-positive signed flow, not decay.' Right about the test, imprecise about decay. The decay E measured on 0529 (-1,573 -> -59) is the covering bid ARRIVING: sell flow being met. Decay measures the RATE at which the residual is being drawn down; only the cumulative signed integral measures the AMOUNT drawn down. So decay is a leading indicator of the cross, and the cross is the consumption EVENT. Keep both, spend the residual only on the integral. This is a strict generalization of E's form, not a defence of mine.
3_adjudication_of_E_s_correction_to_my_C.where_I_correct_E_BACK_2_the_window_must: E's window enumerates SESSIONS. On my seams that is not sufficient. The 0525 window contains the Sunday 05-24 reopen stub - a separately-labelled 2-hour session that carries -173 of signed flow and appears NOWHERE in the phase table; it arrives only through tape_conditions.session_signed_flow. A window defined over the phase table alone silently drops it. Corrected: the window is all TRADED TIME from publication_ts to the seam OPEN, comprising (a) intra-session phase fragments after 15:30 on the publication day, (b) whole intervening sessions from the phase table, and (c) weekend/holiday reopen stubs from tape_conditions.session_signed_flow. This matters for exactly the seams I own.
3_adjudication_of_E_s_correction_to_my_C.where_I_correct_E_BACK_3_consumption_is_: E writes 'any CROSS', which I read as an event, and that reading must be made explicit because the 0605 window does not stay positive: -59, +3,796, +3,524 (cum +7,261 - CROSS), -2,852, -5,662 -> cum -1,253 at the seam. A running-state test would report 'not consumed' at 0605 and re-arm the wrong prior. The residual is a STOCK: buying draws it down, and once drawn down it is gone. Later selling REBUILDS a short stack, but that new stack is not reported until the NEXT publication and cannot arm a seam off the OLD one. Consumption latches.

the_joint_instrument_as_I_now_hold_it.arm: A COT publication with managed-money net at a low 1y-pctile creates an UP residual at publication_ts.
the_joint_instrument_as_I_now_hold_it.window: ALL TRADED TIME from publication_ts to the candidate seam OPEN - post-15:30 phase fragments on the publication day, whole intervening sessions, AND weekend/holiday reopen stubs (tape_conditions.session_signed_flow).
the_joint_instrument_as_I_now_hold_it.test: if cumulative signed flow over that window CROSSES to net-positive at any point, the residual is SPENT - latched, irreversibly, for that publication and every later seam. Decay toward zero without a cross leaves it LOADED. Only a NEW publication rebuilds the stack.
the_joint_instrument_as_I_now_hold_it.supersedes: the RECURRING arm of boundary.seam_gap_up_prior_on_worsening_cot ('RECURRING on every seam while the COT keeps worsening') - falsified here by 0605. 4_I_DO_NOT_ACCEPT_E_S_FLOWLESS_READ_OF_T.E_s_claim: 0529 phase 3 moved price -810 on net signed flow of -59, therefore 'nobody sold this low', the close is a FAKE CLOSE, and the drop reverts - giving the Monday gap a second independent channel worth +570 to +690.
4_I_DO_NOT_ACCEPT_E_S_FLOWLESS_READ_OF_T.the_number_E_did_not_use: 0529 phase 3 volume is 60,930 - the LARGEST-volume phase of the session (ph1 4,715, ph2 51,424). 60,930 lots changed hands. That is not air and it is not thin. It is FULL participation with a NET of essentially zero.
4_I_DO_NOT_ACCEPT_E_S_FLOWLESS_READ_OF_T.why_the_distinction_is_not_pedantic: My 0525 stub is displacement WITHOUT participation: 658 trades, nobody transferred inventory, and the print reverts because no position depends on it. 0529 ph3 is the opposite object: maximal participation, zero net. Inventory was transferred in size at declining prices. SOMEBODY now owns 3.273 and lower. A high-volume net-flat decline is the signature of DISTRIBUTION - a bid stepping down while both sides trade heavily - not of an unowned print.
4_I_DO_NOT_ACCEPT_E_S_FLOWLESS_READ_OF_T.consequence_for_the_bridge: E's gap-UP prior survives, but on ONE channel (the unconsumed COT residual), not two. The flowless-reversion channel is withdrawn. B must NOT treat E's two channels as independent confirmation. And the same correction ARMS E's own intraday call harder than E armed it: if Friday's final phase was distribution under full participation, the distribution did not start on Monday - it started Friday afternoon, and Monday inherits it already running.
4_I_DO_NOT_ACCEPT_E_S_FLOWLESS_READ_OF_T.general_form: Read (volume, net) as a PAIR, never net alone. Low volume + any net = unowned displacement, reverts. High volume + near-zero net = two-sided transfer with a stepping bid, i.e. distribution, does NOT revert and predicts continuation of the price direction. High volume + large aligned net = delivery. High volume + large opposed net = absorption. E's FLOWLESS_BID_WITHDRAWAL is a real fifth exit type; 0529 ph3 is simply not an instance of it. Proposed rename of the discriminator: the exit-type test needs a VOLUME condition, not only a flow condition.
